_meta.purpose: The checked-in roster scripts/check-portal-federation-health.mjs diffs the live registry against, so a product that silently drops out of /api/v1/app-registry/apps (the '13 of 18' symptom) fails loudly instead of producing a shorter-but-still-green table.
_meta.notASlugMigrationWorklist: This file is NOT authority to edit any product's registered `slug`. Per CLAUDE.md §'slug, display name, and the federated serve path are THREE INDEPENDENT questions', slug is free at registration and immutable after. If a live registry slug genuinely differs from an entry below, FIX THIS FILE to match the registry — never the other way around. This list exists only to notice disappearance, not to prescribe naming.
_meta.maintainedBy: owner (izzywdev) — add an entry when a new product joins the family, remove one when a product is formally retired, correct the slug if a `confidence` below turns out wrong.
_meta.countRationale: 19 entries. Re-reconciled against the live registry by census run 34084771931 (2026-09-07), which surfaced three more roster defects as its own warnings. Two entries named a slug the registry has never served while ALSO listing its live twin as absent: 'fuzesales' -> 'sales' and 'fuzeservice' -> 'service' (the census warned "sales is in the registry but not in scripts/expected-portal-apps.json" and the same for 'service', while reporting nothing for the stale entries because those rows do exist -- as stranded duplicates). The third, 'merchandize', was the file's only 'inferred' entry and its own note asked for exactly this check: the product registers 'fuzemerchandize'. Each defect produced a false signal of the kind this roster exists to prevent -- a MISSING that means 'the roster is wrong' is indistinguishable from one that means 'a product dropped out'. The stranded 'fuzesales' and 'fuzeservice' rows are suspended by applications migration 013, so the portal shows one tile per product; the roster now names the surviving slug in each pair.

confidenceLevels.verified: slug read directly from the code that decides it -- either BUILTIN_MANIFESTS in this repo (backend/applications/src/app-registry/builtins.ts) for a built-in, or the product's own registration/manifest.json for a self-registering product, which production stores verbatim (backend/applications/src/app-registry/service.ts: slug: row.slug) and register.sh re-PUTs on every pod start. Cannot be stale without the owning repo changing its own registration.
confidenceLevels.owner-ruling: slug is one of the exact values the owner named on 2026-08-19 (quoted verbatim in CLAUDE.md §'slug, display name, and the federated serve path') as either a prefixed exception to keep (fuzex, fuzebi) or an already-correct unprefixed slug not to be migrated.
confidenceLevels.documented: slug taken from a specific named FuzeFront doc that is not itself flagged RETIRED/historical-snapshot for this purpose, but was not independently re-measured for this file.
confidenceLevels.inferred: no direct citation found; slug is a best guess by family naming convention. Treat a MISSING result for one of these as 'go verify the real slug', not as proof the product is down.

sources: CLAUDE.md §'slug, display name, and the federated serve path are THREE INDEPENDENT questions' (owner ruling, 2026-08-19, quoted verbatim)
packages/onboarding-kit/README.md (FuzeService used as the running naming-convention example)
docs/runbooks/app-slug-deprefix-migration.md — RETIRED; its measured-state table was read only as a last-resort snapshot for products no other source names, and is called out per-entry below

izzywdev/FuzeSales, izzywdev/FuzeService and izzywdev/FuzeMerchandize registration/manifest.json -- each product's own declared slug, which production stores verbatim (backend/applications/src/app-registry/service.ts: slug: row.slug) and register.sh re-PUTs on every pod start
_meta.genuinelyAbsentAtLastReview: Census 34084771931 (2026-09-07) MISSING set, after these corrections: call, fuzebi, fuzeplan, fuzex, fuzemerchandize. 'fuzemerchandize' was previously counted under the wrong slug; the product is genuinely unregistered either way, because its pods are not running (app.fuzefront.com/apps/fuzemerchandize/remoteEntry.js answers 503 -- the Ingress exists, nothing healthy backs it -- so its registration init container never runs).
